source: Unchanged finite open-cubic SU2 Hamiltonian family, r=lambda/kappa; analytic expansion at each fixed box only.

all_box_coefficient_theorem.notations: S=sum_p p, C_p=p^2-1; p is the fundamental trace of plaquette p. Adjacent means sharing a link, not merely a vertex.
all_box_coefficient_theorem.log_normalized_density: log rho=r*S/3+r^2*(-P/18-sum_p C_p/144+sum_{link-adjacent unordered pairs} J_pq)+R_L(r)
all_box_coefficient_theorem.pair_term: J_pq=F0/54-F1/234=(2*x0*y0+8*x_vec dot y_vec)/351, with both loops oriented along their common link.
all_box_coefficient_theorem.disjoint_cancellation: Pairs with disjoint edge supports have electric product energy 6 and cancel exactly from the order-r^2 logarithm, even when the plaquettes share a vertex.
all_box_coefficient_theorem.remainder: R_L(r)=O_L(r^3) at each fixed box. No bound uniform in L is proved.

volume_local_bounds_for_T2.T2: The displayed degree-two log-density polynomial, not the exact log ground density.
volume_local_bounds_for_T2.incidence: At most4 plaquettes per link,12 link-neighbors per plaquette,48 adjacent pair supports incident to a link; pair supports contain7 links.
volume_local_bounds_for_T2.conditional_log_oscillation: osc_e T2 <= (16/3)*|r|+(269/117)*r^2, independent of box size.
volume_local_bounds_for_T2.conditional_TV_row_sum: For the artificial normalized exp(T2) density: sum_(j!=e) c_ej <=8*|r|+(175/26)*r^2, using the log-likelihood oscillation TV bound.
volume_local_bounds_for_T2.small_parameter_control: At |r|=1/16 the certified TV row bound is3503/6656<1.
volume_local_bounds_for_T2.not_claimed: A tensorization constant for the actual source, an actual-source uniform influence bound, or a volume-uniform gap.

remaining_bridge.oscillation: Need sup_(L,e) osc_e R_L(r) controlled beyond the fixed-box Taylor statement.
remaining_bridge.influence: Need a summable mixed-oscillation row bound for R_L, not just a small sup norm or pointwise convergence.
remaining_bridge.functional_inequality: Even an influence estimate must be connected to an applicable conditional tensorization theorem with checked hypotheses and constants.

gate_disposition: faithful-excitation-detection remains open; this is an all-box coefficient theorem and a uniform certificate for the Taylor surrogate only.
